commit 58f8faa5ca46d711b16134ba6beb92242174635f
Author:     serge-sans-paille <sguelton@mozilla.com>
AuthorDate: Mon Mar 3 09:47:33 2025 +0000
Commit:     serge-sans-paille <sguelton@mozilla.com>
CommitDate: Mon Mar 3 09:47:33 2025 +0000

    Bug 1950637 - Move configuration variables from confvars.sh to moz.configure r=coreycb
    
    This matches the recent configuration changes in mozilla-central: only
    variable flagged as confvar should be set in confvars.sh
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D239871

diff --git a/mail/confvars.sh b/mail/confvars.sh
index 9c171796d98..cda9184b6b4 100755
--- a/mail/confvars.sh
+++ b/mail/confvars.sh
@@ -3,7 +3,4 @@
 # License, v. 2.0. If a copy of the MPL was not distributed with this
 # file, You can obtain one at http://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/.
 
-MOZ_APP_NAME=thunderbird
-MOZ_APP_PROFILE=thunderbird
-
 MOZ_BRANDING_DIRECTORY=comm/mail/branding/nightly
diff --git a/mail/moz.configure b/mail/moz.configure
index ccf3f9ae040..0d2bfde4efe 100644
--- a/mail/moz.configure
+++ b/mail/moz.configure
@@ -7,6 +7,8 @@
 set_config("MOZ_THUNDERBIRD", True)
 set_define("MOZ_THUNDERBIRD", True)
 
+imply_option("MOZ_APP_NAME", "thunderbird")
+imply_option("MOZ_APP_PROFILE", "thunderbird")
 imply_option("MOZ_APP_BASENAME", "Thunderbird")
 set_config("MOZ_APPUPDATE_HOST", "aus.thunderbird.net")
 
diff --git a/suite/confvars.sh b/suite/confvars.sh
index 1fed70b91aa..8471b27eeff 100755
--- a/suite/confvars.sh
+++ b/suite/confvars.sh
@@ -3,17 +3,5 @@
 # License, v. 2.0. If a copy of the MPL was not distributed with this
 # file, You can obtain one at http://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/.
 
-MOZ_APP_NAME=seamonkey
-MOZ_APP_DISPLAYNAME=SeaMonkey
-
-MOZ_APP_VERSION=$SEAMONKEY_VERSION
-MOZ_APP_VERSION_DISPLAY=$SEAMONKEY_VERSION_DISPLAY
-# MOZ_PKG_VERSION=$SEAMONKEY_VERSION_PACKAGE
-
-BROWSER_CHROME_URL=chrome://navigator/content/navigator.xul
-
 MOZ_BRANDING_DIRECTORY=comm/suite/branding/seamonkey
 MOZ_OFFICIAL_BRANDING_DIRECTORY=comm/suite/branding/seamonkey
-MOZ_UPDATER=1
-
-MOZ_PROFILE_MIGRATOR=1
diff --git a/suite/moz.configure b/suite/moz.configure
index 3b750e574df..8dd355c6ffb 100644
--- a/suite/moz.configure
+++ b/suite/moz.configure
@@ -7,9 +7,15 @@
 set_config("MOZ_SUITE", True)
 set_define("MOZ_SUITE", True)
 
+imply_option("MOZ_APP_NAME", "seamonkey")
 imply_option("MOZ_APP_BASENAME", "SeaMonkey")
+imply_option("MOZ_APP_DISPLAYNAME", "SeaMonkey")
+
 imply_option("MOZ_APP_ID", "{92650c4d-4b8e-4d2a-b7eb-24ecf4f6b63a}")
 imply_option("MOZ_APP_VENDOR", "Mozilla")
+
+imply_option("MOZ_UPDATER", True)
+imply_option("MOZ_PROFILE_MIGRATOR", True)
 # Include the DevTools client, not just the server (which is the default)
 imply_option("MOZ_DEVTOOLS", "all")
 imply_option("NSS_EXTRA_SYMBOLS_FILE", "../comm/mailnews/nss-extra.symbols")
@@ -82,6 +88,9 @@ set_defconf("SEAMONKEY_VERSION", seamonkey_version.version)
 set_defconf("SEAMONKEY_VERSION_DISPLAY", seamonkey_version.version_display)
 # Currently not set in suite comm-central
 # set_defconf("MOZ_PKG_VERSION", seamonkey_version.version_package)
+imply_option("MOZ_APP_VERSION", seamonkey_version.version)
+imply_option("MOZ_APP_VERSION_DISPLAY", seamonkey_version.version_display)
+imply_option("BROWSER_CHROME_URL", "chrome://navigator/content/navigator.xul")
 
 
 imply_option("MOZ_PLACES", True)
